description: This file implements a WebSocket client for Mattermost, handling connection setup, message sending, ping/pong handling, and event processing.

classes.name: WebSocketClient
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket client managing connection, messaging, and ping/pong handling.

methods.name: NewWebSocketClient
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket client with default dialer.

methods.name: NewReliableWebSocketClientWithDialer
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket client with a custom dialer, connection ID, and sequence number.

methods.name: NewWebSocketClientWithDialer
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket client with a custom dialer.

methods.name: makeClient
methods.description: Internal function to initialize a WebSocketClient instance.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection using the default dialer.

methods.name: ConnectWithDialer
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection using a specified dialer.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: writer
methods.description: Handles outgoing WebSocket messages.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Starts reading messages from the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a JSON message over WebSocket.

methods.name: SendBinaryMessage
methods.description: Sends a binary message over WebSocket.

methods.name: UserTyping
methods.description: Sends a user typing event.

methods.name: GetStatuses
methods.description: Requests user statuses.

methods.name: GetStatusesByIds
methods.description: Requests statuses for specific user IDs.

methods.name: UpdateActiveChannel
methods.description: Updates the active channel.

methods.name: UpdateActiveTeam
methods.description: Updates the active team.

methods.name: UpdateActiveThread
methods.description: Updates the active thread.

methods.name: configurePingHandling
methods.description: Sets up ping/pong handlers and watchdog.

methods.name: pingHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming ping messages.

methods.name: pingWatchdog
methods.description: Monitors ping timeouts and triggers actions.
